summary: John's maternal 2nd great-grandfather; Bisaccia-born blacksmith of Dunmore, father of Carmela 'Mollie' Gianetta.
bio: Not in the Ancestry tree; identified in Round 2. FS tree LCPG-XKM (14-17 sources): Francesco 'Frank' Giannetta/Genett, b. 2 May 1869 Bisaccia (AV), son of Savino Giannetta (b. 1842) and Angelamaria Fede; immigrated about 1906; naturalized in Scranton (1920/1923, Middle District Court); lived in Dunmore Ward 5 1910-30; died in Dunmore 1934. 1931 marriage license of his daughter: father Frank, a blacksmith born in Italy, living in Dunmore. Round 3 read his Declaration of Intention No. 16537, US District Court, Scranton, 12 Jul 1920, under the name 'Frank Gennetti': born 2 May 1869 'Bisiccio' [Bisaccia]; aged 50; laborer; of 133 Sand St, Dunmore (Mollie's 1931 address); sailed from Naples on the SS Italia, arriving New York c.15 Apr 1903 (FS profile says 1906); last foreign residence Bisaccia; wife Angelina born in Italy. Marriage, Bisaccia, 1 Aug 1896, Matrimoni 1896 act 18 (FS's '1886' is a typo; Round 2 had flagged 1886 as impossible since Angelica would have been about 12): groom 27, possidente, son of the living Savino and Angelamaria Fede; bride Angelica Ferrantino, 23, born Sant'Angelo dei Lombardi, resident in Bisaccia, foundling. paese.app counts 916 US arrivals from Bisaccia 1830-1912, peaking in 1906, the year FS says he came. Bisaccia is about 12 km from Guardia Lombardi.
